score_note: Free with an account; the binary cannot be redistributed.
description: A spectral warping wavetable synthesizer with a visual, drag-and-drop interface, three oscillators, a flexible modulation system and built-in effects. The download is free but needs an account at vital.audio, so it is a link here; once you install it, Slimphonic finds it.
name: Vital

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: Download needs a free account at vital.audio. After installing, the plugin appears in the Instruments tab.
